title: skills: the six metadata skills trigger on what the user is doing, not on TypeScript file names
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

A person builds an app through MCP, with no project files at all. None of the metadata skills fires, because each one's description says it applies to `*.object.ts` or `*.flow.ts`.

Who acts: the skills lane (`skills/objectstack-{data,ui,automation,formula,i18n,query}/SKILL.md` frontmatter and evals). Governed surface.

## Evidence

- Every metadata skill's `description` triggers on TypeScript file globs; only `objectstack-i18n` also names the metadata API.
- 13 vendor skill sets read at source (Supabase, Convex, NocoBase, Stripe, Vercel, Anthropic, Directus, Clerk, Cloudflare, Neon, dbt, Prisma, Salesforce): none triggers on file globs; all trigger on tasks or intents.
- Directus records the effect of a fixed description opener on a small model: 22 of 37 trigger cases before, 33–34 after.
- Claude Code truncates a skill description at 1,536 characters.

## Scope

- Each description leads with the task ("designing or changing objects and fields, in a project or through MCP"), keeps file globs as a secondary cue, and ends with a "Not for" clause naming the neighbouring skill. Target 300–450 characters.
- No body change in this card.

## Done when

- The trigger cases of the runner card pass at a higher rate after than before, on the weakest model the eval seat tracks, with no new false trigger on the negative cases.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Decision record: #34691 S3 = A. Blocked on measurement by the runner card, not on authoring.
- Dedup, open and closed: none found for `skill description trigger`.
